cn_steps: 启用 `Scribble`（运行时 `Scribble`，编辑器 `ScribbleEditor`）。
它提供涂鸦功能的用户界面（在视口/面板里手绘批注）。
在审阅或协作时打开涂鸦层，在画面上画标记。
属实验性 UI 工具；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Scribble` (runtime `Scribble`, editor `ScribbleEditor`).
It provides a scribble UI (hand-drawn annotations in a viewport/panel).
Open the scribble layer during review/collab and mark up the frame.
It is an experimental UI tool; editor modules are Editor-target only.
note_cn: 在视口/面板里手绘批注的涂鸦 UI。
note_en: Scribble UI for hand-drawn viewport/panel annotations.

cn_steps: 启用 `Script Plugin`（模块 `ScriptPlugin`、`ScriptEditorPlugin`）。
它是脚本插件的示例，可作为创建自己的脚本插件的起点。
对照其模块划分和编辑器挂钩去搭自己的脚本宿主，而不是当生产脚本方案。
属示例插件；不要当 Shipping 脚本运行时。
en_steps: Enable `Script Plugin` (modules `ScriptPlugin`, `ScriptEditorPlugin`).
It is a sample script plugin, a starting point when creating your own.
Copy its module split and editor hooks to host your own scripting; not a production script runtime.
It is a sample plugin; do not ship it as the script runtime.
note_cn: 脚本插件示例，可作自研脚本插件起点。
note_en: Sample script plugin; a starting point for your own.

cn_steps: 启用 `Scriptable Tools Editor Mode`（模块 `ScriptableToolsEditorMode`）。
它是可脚本工具（Scriptable Tools）的编辑器模式。
在 Modes 里打开该模式，运行用蓝图编写的交互工具。
属编辑器模式；需 Scriptable Tools Framework，默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `Scriptable Tools Editor Mode` (module `ScriptableToolsEditorMode`).
It is the editor mode for Scriptable Tools.
Open this mode in Modes to run interactive tools authored in Blueprint.
It is an editor mode; requires Scriptable Tools Framework; does not ship by default.
note_cn: 运行蓝图可脚本工具的编辑器模式。
note_en: Editor mode for running Blueprint Scriptable Tools.

cn_steps: 启用 `Scriptable Tools Framework`（模块 `ScriptableToolsFramework`、`EditorScriptableToolsFramework`）。
它是 Interactive Tools Framework 的蓝图可脚本扩展。
用蓝图编写交互工具，再在 Scriptable Tools 编辑器模式里运行。
运行时框架可进工具；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Scriptable Tools Framework` (modules `ScriptableToolsFramework`, `EditorScriptableToolsFramework`).
It is a Blueprint-scriptable extension of the Interactive Tools Framework.
Author interactive tools in Blueprint, then run them in Scriptable Tools editor mode.
The runtime framework can ship with tools; editor modules are Editor-target only.
note_cn: Interactive Tools Framework 的蓝图可脚本扩展。
note_en: Blueprint-scriptable extension of the Interactive Tools Framework.

cn_steps: 启用 `Security Sandbox`（模块 `SecuritySandbox`）。
它帮助降低游戏客户端运行时的操作系统权限，从而减小被漏洞控制后对玩家的影响。
在 Windows 等目标上启用沙箱，按平台文档配置受限令牌/作业对象。
属客户端安全加固；按目标平台验证兼容性。
en_steps: Enable `Security Sandbox` (module `SecuritySandbox`).
It helps reduce OS permissions the game client runs with, limiting impact if an attacker takes control via a vulnerability.
Enable the sandbox on Windows (and similar) targets and configure restricted tokens/job objects per platform docs.
It is client security hardening; validate compatibility per target platform.
note_cn: 降低游戏客户端 OS 权限的安全沙箱。
note_en: Security sandbox to reduce the game client's OS permissions.

cn_steps: 启用 `Semantic Search`（模块 `SemanticSearch`、`SemanticSearchEditorIntegrations`）。
它是资产语义搜索的早期实现，目前需要自定义远程 Embedding 提供方才能使用。
配置远程嵌入服务后，用自然语言在内容浏览器里搜资产。
属早期实验；接口和提供方要求可能变化。
en_steps: Enable `Semantic Search` (modules `SemanticSearch`, `SemanticSearchEditorIntegrations`).
It is very early work on semantic search for assets; currently needs a custom remote embedding provider.
Configure the remote embedding service, then search assets in the Content Browser with natural language.
It is early experimental work; the API and provider requirements may change.
note_cn: 资产语义搜索（需自定义远程 Embedding）。
note_en: Semantic asset search (needs a custom remote embedding provider).

cn_steps: 启用 `Sequence Navigator`（模块 `SequenceNavigator`）。
它是带编辑能力的高级序列面包屑工具（在嵌套序列之间导航）。
在 Sequencer 里用面包屑跳进/跳出子镜头，并就地编辑。
属 Sequencer 编辑器工具。
en_steps: Enable `Sequence Navigator` (module `SequenceNavigator`).
It is an advanced sequence breadcrumb tool with editing (navigate nested sequences).
Use breadcrumbs in Sequencer to jump into/out of shots and edit in place.
It is a Sequencer editor tool.
note_cn: 带编辑能力的序列面包屑导航。

cn_steps: 启用 `Sequence Validator`（模块 `SequenceValidator`）。
它提供验证规则，用于检测序列中的常见错误。
在提交/出片前跑校验，抓住缺失绑定、空镜头等 Sequencer 问题。
属 Sequencer 质检工具。
en_steps: Enable `Sequence Validator` (module `SequenceValidator`).
It provides validation rules for detecting common errors in sequences.
Run validation before submit/delivery to catch missing bindings, empty shots, and similar Sequencer issues.
It is a Sequencer QC tool.
note_cn: 检测 Sequencer 常见错误的校验规则。
note_en: Validation rules for common Sequencer errors.

cn_steps: 启用 `Sequencer Anim Mixer`（模块 `MovieSceneAnimMixer`、`MovieSceneAnimMixerEditor`、`MovieSceneAnimMixerScripting`）。
它是在序列里混合分层动画的系统。
在 Sequencer 里加 Anim Mixer，把多层动画按权重叠在角色上。
属实验性 Sequencer 动画扩展；脚本模块可给 Python 用。
en_steps: Enable `Sequencer Anim Mixer` (modules `MovieSceneAnimMixer`, `MovieSceneAnimMixerEditor`, `MovieSceneAnimMixerScripting`).
It is a system for mixing layered animation in sequences.
Add an Anim Mixer in Sequencer and blend multiple animation layers onto a character by weight.
It is an experimental Sequencer animation extension; the scripting module is for Python.
note_cn: 在 Sequencer 里混合分层动画。

cn_steps: 启用 `Sequencer Anim Tools`（模块 `SequencerAnimTools`）。
它提供面向 Sequencer 和 Control Rig 的动画工具。
在动画制作流程里用这些工具辅助关键帧/绑定操作。
属编辑器动画工具；默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `Sequencer Anim Tools` (module `SequencerAnimTools`).
It provides animation tools for Sequencer and Control Rig.
Use these tools in the animation authoring flow to assist keyframing/rigging.
It is an editor animation tool; it does not ship by default.
note_cn: 面向 Sequencer 与 Control Rig 的动画工具。
note_en: Animation tools for Sequencer and Control Rig.

cn_steps: 启用 `Sequencer Mixed Control Rig`（运行时 `MovieSceneMixedControlRig`，编辑器 `MovieSceneMixedControlRigEditor`）。
它在 Sequencer 里支持混合 Control Rig（多层/混合绑定驱动）。
在镜头里叠多套 Control Rig 贡献，而不是单一绑定轨。
属实验性 Sequencer/Control Rig 扩展。
en_steps: Enable `Sequencer Mixed Control Rig` (runtime `MovieSceneMixedControlRig`, editor `MovieSceneMixedControlRigEditor`).
It supports mixed Control Rig in Sequencer (layered/blended rig drives).
Stack multiple Control Rig contributions on a shot instead of a single rig track.
It is an experimental Sequencer/Control Rig extension.
note_cn: 在 Sequencer 里混合多层 Control Rig。
note_en: Mix layered Control Rigs in Sequencer.

cn_steps: 启用 `Sequencer Scripting`（模块 `SequencerScripting`、`SequencerScriptingEditor`）。
它为 Sequencer 和 Movie Scene 提供 Python 与编辑器实用程序脚本扩展。
用 Python 创建/修改 Level Sequence、轨道与绑定，做批处理。
属编辑器脚本扩展；需 Python 脚本插件。
en_steps: Enable `Sequencer Scripting` (modules `SequencerScripting`, `SequencerScriptingEditor`).
It adds Python and editor-utility scripting extensions for Sequencer and Movie Scene.
Create/modify Level Sequences, tracks, and bindings from Python for batch work.
It is an editor scripting extension; requires the Python script plugin.
note_cn: Sequencer / Movie Scene 的 Python 脚本扩展。
note_en: Python scripting extensions for Sequencer and Movie Scene.

cn_steps: 启用 `SequencerAnimMixerToolset`（EDA 工具集内容，无独立运行时模块列表）。
它是 Sequencer 动画混合器的 EDA 工具集。
通过 AI/EDA 工具集注册表操作 Anim Mixer，而不是当 Shipping 功能。
属 Toolset；需 Sequencer Anim Mixer。
en_steps: Enable `SequencerAnimMixerToolset` (EDA toolset content; no separate runtime module list).
It is an EDA toolset for the Sequencer Animation Mixer.
Drive the Anim Mixer via the AI/EDA Toolset Registry; not a shipping gameplay feature.
It is a Toolset; requires Sequencer Anim Mixer.
note_cn: 操作 Sequencer 动画混合器的 EDA 工具集。
note_en: EDA toolset for the Sequencer Animation Mixer.

cn_steps: 启用 `Serialization Utils`（模块 `JsonSerialization`、`XmlSerialization`）。
它提供带扩展功能的 JSON/XML 等序列化实用程序。
读写自定义 JSON/XML 配置或中间数据时依赖这些模块。
属通用序列化工具；按格式选用对应模块。
en_steps: Enable `Serialization Utils` (modules `JsonSerialization`, `XmlSerialization`).
It provides serialization utilities (JSON, XML, etc.) with extended functionality.
Depend on these modules when reading/writing custom JSON/XML config or interchange data.
It is a general serialization toolkit; pick the module for the format you need.
note_cn: 带扩展功能的 JSON/XML 序列化工具。
note_en: JSON/XML serialization utilities with extended features.

cn_steps: 启用 `Shader Toolkit`（模块 `ShaderAuditCore`、`ShaderAudit`）。
它分析项目构建与着色器，帮助减少着色器和材质排列。
跑 Shader Audit，找出多余排列并收敛材质/质量开关。
属编辑器着色器审计工具；默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `Shader Toolkit` (modules `ShaderAuditCore`, `ShaderAudit`).
It analyzes the project build and shaders to help reduce shader and material permutations.
Run Shader Audit, find extra permutations, and tighten material/quality switches.
It is an editor shader-audit tool; it does not ship by default.
note_cn: 分析并减少着色器/材质排列的审计工具。
note_en: Audit tools to analyze and reduce shader/material permutations.
